To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the low molecular weight biopolymers such as low viscosity grade guar gum and low degree of methoxylated pectin are suitable for colon specific formulation design and the formulation can be evaluated in human by Gamma scintigraphy imaging.
compression coating with low molecular weight polysaccharide is a promising platform technology for colonic drug and protein delivery.
the compression coated tablets with low molecular weight natural polymers are suitable for colonic drug delivery and can be used for site-specific drug delivery.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel oral colon targeted drug delivery systems using low molecular weight natural biopolymers.
the development of a novel approach for colonic drug delivery.
the design and evaluation of a novel colon targeting drug delivery system using natural biopolymer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the low molecular weight natural biopolymer can be used as an excipient for colonic drug delivery.
compression coating of drug with low molecular weight polysaccharide can serve as a promising platform technology for colonic targeting.
compression coating design of tablets with low molecular weight and viscosity grade biopolymer can be used as a platform technology for colon targeted drug delivery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully demonstrated the potential of low molecular weighted biopolymers as site specific delivery system to the colon in human.
the low molecular weight and lower viscosity grades of Guar gum and Pectin can be used for colonic targeting of drugs by compression coating technology.
low molecular weight natural biopolymers can be used for colonic targeting and can be applied for other therapeutic areas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the low molecular weight natural biopolymer with low degree of substitution can be used for colon targeted drug delivery.
we have demonstrated a novel and efficient approach for colon targeting using compression coated tablet formulation and low molecular weight natural polymer.

the formulation design of compression coated tablet with low molecular weight natural biopolymer can be used to deliver other potential drugs to the colon for local and/or systematic effects in other therapeutic applications.
